info.title: [VGE-D-SD03] Start Deck 03: Tohya Ebata -Apex Ruler- ｜ ｜ Card List ｜ Cardfight!! Vanguard Trading Card Game | Official Website

cards.text:
D-SD03/001EN
Apex Ruler, Bastion
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[CONT](VC):During your turn, all of your grade 3 units get [Power] +2000.
[AUTO](VC)[1/turn]:At the end of the battle that your drive check revealed a grade 3, [COST][discard a card from your hand], choose one of your rear-guards, [Stand] it, and it gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn.

D-SD03/002EN
Knight of Heavenly Spear, Rooks
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 2｜ Power 10000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon by "Apex Ruler, Bastion", [COST][reveal three grade 3 cards from your hand], and draw a card.
[CONT](RC):During your turn, if you have three or more grade 3 units, this unit gets "Boost", and [Power] +5000.

D-SD03/003EN
Knight of Heavenly Sword, Fort
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon by "Knight of Heavenly Spear, Rooks", [COST][reveal two grade 3 cards from your hand], reveal the top card of your deck, call it to (RC) if it is a unit card, and put it into your drop if it isn't.
[ACT](RC)[1/turn]:[COST][Counter-Blast 1], choose one of your grade 3 vanguards, and it gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn.

D-SD03/004EN
Knight of Heavenly Bow, Base
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 0｜ Power 6000｜ Shield 5000
[AUTO]:When this unit is rode upon, if you went second, draw a card.

D-SD03/005EN
Vehement Witch, Ramana
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[AUTO](RC):When this unit attacks, [COST][Counter-Blast 1], and this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of that battle.

D-SD03/006EN
Knight of Broadaxe, Rafluke
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 3｜ Power 13000｜ Shield -
[ACT](RC):[COST][Put this unit into your soul], choose one of your grade 3 rear-guards, and it gets [Power] +10000 until end of turn.

D-SD03/007EN
Shadow Bow Archer, Lisana
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
-

D-SD03/008EN
Platinum Wolf
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 1｜ Power 8000｜ Shield 5000
[ACT](RC):[COST][Soul-Blast 2], and this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn.

D-SD03/009EN
Lifesaving Angel, Kurabiel
Normal Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 1｜ Power 7000｜ Shield 0
[CONT]:Sentinel (You may only have up to four cards with "[CONT]:Sentinel" in a deck.)
[AUTO]:When this unit is put on (GC), [COST][discard a card from your hand], choose one of your units, and it cannot be hit until end of that battle.

D-SD03/010EN
Spiritual King of Determination, Olbaria
Trigger Unit｜ -｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 50000
(You may only have one [Over] trigger in a deck. When revealed as a trigger, remove that card, draw a card, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] Trigger +100 Million until end of turn! If revealed during drive check, activate its additional effect!)
Additional Effect - Choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] Trigger +100 Million until end of turn!

D-SD03/011EN
Knight of Heavenly Hammer, Gurgant
Trigger Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
(When revealed as a trigger, choose one of your units, and it gets [Critical] Trigger +1 until end of turn! Then, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] Trigger +10000 until end of turn!)

D-SD03/012EN
Knight of Heavenly Pierce, Gallus
Trigger Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 5000
(When revealed as a trigger, draw a card! Then, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] Trigger +10000 until end of turn!)

D-SD03/013EN
Knight of Heavenly Rend, Lif
Trigger Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
(When revealed as a trigger, all of your front row units get [Power] Trigger +10000 until end of turn!)

D-SD03/014EN
Healer of Heavenly Staff, Arshes
Trigger Unit｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 0｜ Power 5000｜ Shield 15000
(You may only have up to four [Heal] triggers in a deck. When revealed as a trigger, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] Trigger +10000 until end of turn! Then, if the number of cards in your damage zone is equal to or more than your opponent's, choose a card from your damage zone, and heal it!)

D-SD03/015EN
The Hour of Holy Judgement Cometh
Normal Order｜ Keter Sanctuary｜ Grade 3｜ Power -｜ Shield -
Play this with [COST][Counter-Blast 2]!
Draw two cards, choose one of your units, and it gets [Power] +5000 until end of turn!
